sources.role: RetroArch core identity, BIOS requirements, saves and states

paths.naming: RetroArch libretro config syntax (key = "value"); core options are stored under the beetle_psx core identity.
RetroPad bindings use input_playerN_<button>_btn/_axis in retroarch.cfg; autoconfig profiles use input_<button>_btn/input_<axis>_axis.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/saves/ (or next to content when savefile_directory is unset)
paths.naming: Persistent PlayStation memory cards use RetroArch .srm files; Beetle PSX also accepts memory-card .mcr data where documented.; RetroArch normally uses <content-basename>.srm and related core/content sidecars where applicable.
evidence: source:records/retroarch.json RetroArch save paths and naming

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/states/ (or next to content when savestate_directory is unset)
paths.naming: Serialized RetroArch states use .state/.stateN.; frontend slot 0 is <content-basename>.state and slots N are .stateN.
evidence: source:records/retroarch.json RetroArch state paths and naming

paths.naming: PlayStation BIOS is content/region dependent. Official docs name scph5500.bin, scph5501.bin and scph5502.bin variants; no checksum is copied here without a revision-pinned digest source.
